params.name: snapshot_timestamp
params.description: Return findings for a given snapshot of time (Unix ms).

params.name: page[cursor]
params.description: Return the next page of findings pointed to by the cursor.

params.name: filter[tags]
params.description: Return findings that have these associated tags (repeatable).

params.name: filter[evaluation_changed_at]
params.description: Return findings that have changed from pass to fail or vice versa on a specified date (Unix ms) or date range (using comparison operators).

params.name: filter[muted]
params.description: Set to `true` to return findings that are muted. Set to `false` to return unmuted findings.

params.name: filter[rule_id]

params.name: filter[status]

params.name: filter[vulnerability_type]
params.description: Return findings that match the selected vulnerability types (repeatable).

items.docs:
Get a list of findings. These include both misconfigurations and identity risks.

**Note**: To filter and return only identity risks, add the following query parameter: `?filter[tags]=dd_rule_type:ciem`

### Filtering

Filters can be applied by appending query parameters to the URL.

  - Using a single filter: `?filter[attribute_key]=attribute_value`
  - Chaining filters: `?filter[attribute_key]=attribute_value&filter[attribute_key]=attribute_value...`
  - Filtering on tags: `?filter[tags]=tag_k
